about: Three test vectors for the challenge stamp of poiesis-insight 2.0.0. `text` is the conclusion's sentence as it is found; `normalised` is what is hashed (UTF-8). The same vectors are in challenge-stamp-format.md.

vectors.name: plain: one line, with an en dash and a per cent sign that stay as typed
vectors.text: Topic A has more works each year than the year before, from 12 (2016) to 40 (2024). Its share of the sample went from 0.5% to 1.5%, growing about 20% a year in 2016–20 and about 10% in 2020–24.
vectors.normalised: Topic A has more works each year than the year before, from 12 (2016) to 40 (2024). Its share of the sample went from 0.5% to 1.5%, growing about 20% a year in 2016–20 and about 10% in 2020–24.

vectors.name: layout and accents: wrapped lines, a tab, double spaces, a carriage return, and letters typed as a base letter plus a combining mark
vectors.text:
Această propoziție e inventată pentru test: rânduri rupte,
  un tab	și spații duble,  iar fiecare ă e scris ca literă plus semn.
vectors.normalised: Această propoziție e inventată pentru test: rânduri rupte, un tab și spații duble, iar fiecare ă e scris ca literă plus semn.

vectors.name: from a note: the sentence is the heading above the Id line
